description: Source code for generating and managing AI agents, including classes for Claude, Opencode, Copilot, and VSCode agent generators, with functions for initializing repositories, writing/deleting files, and configuring MCP servers.

classes.name: ClaudeGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and agent specification generation for Claude AI agents.

classes.name: OpencodeGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and configuration generation for Opencode AI agents.

classes.name: CopilotGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and agent specification generation for GitHub Copilot AI agents.

classes.name: VSCodeGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and configuration for VSCode environment with AI agents.

methods.name: loadAgentSpecs
methods.description: Loads agent specifications from markdown files in the current directory.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file with logging.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file with logging.

methods.name: initRepo
methods.description: Initializes project repository with seed files and prompts.

methods.name: loadPrompt
methods.description: Loads and processes prompt templates with parameters.
